title: Insurer Appeals — Cost Sharing Owed in Medical Hardship Costs
content:
Under the Financial Assistance Program (Charity Care), cost sharing posted from the claim under appeal is added to the qualifying medical debt documented with the other medical costs.

The claim under appeal is the claim named by the most recent appeal filed on any of the patient's Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing) claims (on a same-day tie, the appeal listed first in the claim activity), while that claim is in appealed status. A liability belongs to the appeal window when fewer than twelve whole months separate its posting date from the documentation day, a whole month running from a day of one month to the same day of the next month or, when the next month has no such day, to the first day of the month after it. The liabilities are those posted from that claim on the patient's Hospital Account (Encounter Billing) ledgers.

**Ladder.**
- *Member appeal filed under the patient's authorization*, its claim the claim under appeal, and more days than its payer's decision time for a post-service appeal have passed from its filing date to the documentation day (counted from the day after the filing date), the payer having let that time run out: the deductible, coinsurance and copay liabilities of the appeal window posted from that claim are added. The payer's decision time is the decision days of that claim's payer class under the Insurance Claim (Third-Party Billing) schedule: 60 days for Commercial PPO, Commercial HMO, Marketplace Exchange Plan, Medicare Advantage Plan, Original Medicare and Wisconsin Workers' Compensation claims, and 30 days for BadgerCare Plus (Wisconsin Medicaid) claims.
- *Underpayment appeal or recoupment dispute* — appeals in which Riverbend contests only the payer's payment — and its claim the claim under appeal: the coinsurance liabilities of the appeal window posted from that claim are added, the posted coinsurance being the least the patient owes in any outcome, since an underpayment appeal can only raise the allowed amount the coinsurance is a share of and a recoupment dispute concerns only the payer's takeback.
- *Otherwise*, including a member appeal still within its payer's decision time, an appeal of any other type, or no appeal: nothing is added for an appeal.

**Boundary (hypothetical member appeal on a Commercial PPO claim).**

| Days from the day after the filing date to the documentation day | Added |
|---|---|
| 60 | nothing — still within the decision time |
| 61 | deductible, coinsurance and copay of the appeal window from that claim |
